title: Sanjay ki Tasveer
story: Dadi's younger brother Sanjay left the village after her wedding in 1982. Every year he comes back to this mela and waits at the santra goli stall at 5:30 in the evening, the santra goli the two of them shared as children. This year he has left a trail of santra goli wrappers, each holding one of his childhood paheliyan (riddles) and one torn piece of his photo. Following the trail retraces his day: Pappu's cart, Pappu's whistle stall, kulfi, the giant wheel, the bangle stall of their mausi, the 1982 wedding photo, and finally the santra goli stall, where he is waiting.

puzzles.place: Pappu's bullock cart, jute sack stencilled "PAPPU"
puzzles.meaning: Pappu's stall number. Sanjay came to the mela on his friend Pappu's cart, then went to Pappu's stall.

answerSource.object: board "पप्पू २३ Toy stop" on Pappu's stall

needs.item: Jute sack on the bullock cart stencilled in English: PAPPU
Pappu's stall board in Devanagari: पप्पू २३ (stall number 23), "Toy stop"

hi.riddle:
पप्पू की बैलगाड़ी पर, मैं मेले तक आया,
बोरी पर उसका नाम लिखा, अंग्रेज़ी में छपाया।
उस पार उसकी दुकान खड़ी, नाम वहाँ हिंदी में,
नाम के संग जो अंक लिखा, वो भर दो इन खानों में।
hi.solved: हाँ, तेईस! पप्पू की दुकान तेईस नंबर। वहीं से मैंने दीदी के लिए रंगीन फिरकी ली थी।

en.riddle:
On Pappu's bullock cart I rode into the fair,
His name is on the sack, in English letters there.
Across, you'll find his stall, his name in Hindi signs,
The number painted with it goes into these lines.
en.solved: Yes, twenty-three! Pappu's stall number. That's where I bought a colourful pinwheel for Didi.

puzzles.meaning: The price of one kulfi. After buying a pinwheel at Pappu's, Sanjay cooled off with a matka kulfi.

needs.item: Pappu's Toy stop stall with a pinwheel; a santra goli packet over its counter
Kulfi stall with a big clay matka, sign: कुल्फ़ी ₹१५

hi.riddle:
पप्पू से ली रंगीन फिरकी, फिर गर्मी ने सताया,
बड़े-से मटके वाली कुल्फ़ी ने, फिर ठंडक का घर पाया।
उस पार कुल्फ़ी वाले की, तख़्ती पर दाम लिखा है,
जितने में मैंने कुल्फ़ी खाई, वही अंक छिपा है।
hi.solved: पंद्रह रुपये! इतने में मैंने बड़े मटके वाली ठंडी कुल्फ़ी खाई, बचपन जैसी।

en.riddle:
From Pappu I bought a pinwheel, then the heat came on strong,
A big clay matka of kulfi kept me cool all along.
Across, the kulfi seller has a sign that shows the rate,
The rupees that I paid for kulfi: that's the number to state.
en.solved: Fifteen rupees! That's what my kulfi from the big matka cost, just like when we were children.

puzzles.place: Kulfi counter, next to the pink "GIANT WHEEL" ticket half
puzzles.meaning: The giant-wheel cabin Sanjay rode. His ticket tore in two at the kulfi stall.

answerSource.object: right half of the pink ticket "6", on the ground where the kids pick up santra goli

needs.item: Pink ticket half on the kulfi counter: "GIANT WHEEL" (torn), with a santra goli beside it
Right half of the same pink ticket on the ground, by the kids picking up santra goli: "6"
Giant wheel cabins with number plates 11 to 18
Giant wheel cabins numbered 11 to 18 (only one ends in 6)

hi.riddle:
कुल्फ़ी खा के झूले का, टिकट मैंने निकाला,
जल्दी में वो फट गया, आधा यहीं पे डाला।
बाक़ी आधा अंक लिए, बच्चों के पास जा पड़ा,
उसी अंक पे ख़त्म हो जो, वो डिब्बा ढूँढो ज़रा।
hi.solved: डिब्बा सोलह! नीला, पीला, फिर नीला। सबसे ऊपर पहुँच के मैंने पूरा मेला देखा।

en.riddle:
After kulfi I bought a ticket for the giant wheel's ride,
In my hurry it tore in two; one half fell by my side.
The half with the number flew where the children play,
Find the cabin ending in it: I rode in it that day.
en.solved: Cabin sixteen! Blue, yellow, then blue. From the very top I saw the whole mela.

puzzles.meaning: Price of a dozen bangles (₹50). From the top of the wheel Sanjay saw the bangle stall and bought Didi a dozen.

needs.item: Cabin 16 striped blue-yellow-blue, with a santra goli packet
Bangle stall with a board: ₹50 हर दर्जन

hi.riddle:
सोलह नंबर डिब्बे से, मैंने देखा सारा मेला,
नीचे चूड़ी की दुकान पे, रंगों का था रेला।
दीदी के लिए चूड़ी ली, दाम की तख़्ती देखो,
एक दर्जन कितने की थी? वही अंक यहाँ लिखो।
hi.solved: पचास रुपये दर्जन! मौसी ने मुझे पहचान लिया, और दीदी के नाप की चूड़ियाँ ख़ुद चुनीं।

en.riddle:
From cabin number sixteen I looked down on the fair,
A stall of shining bangles, every colour there.
I bought a dozen for Didi; the price is on a board,
How much was one dozen? Type in what I paid for the hoard.
en.solved: Fifty rupees a dozen! Mausi knew me at once, and chose Didi's size herself.

puzzles.place: Bangle stall: santra goli on the sellers' purple mat
puzzles.meaning: The year of Didi's (Dadi's) wedding, the day brother and sister parted. The jaimala photo at the studio is dated 1982.

answerSource.object: year "1982" written under the jaimala photo

needs.item: Bangle sellers on a purple mat, with a santra goli on the mat
Photo studio: framed sepia jaimala (wedding) photo on an easel, "1982" written under the photo

hi.riddle:
मौसी से चूड़ी ली मैंने, दीदी, तेरे नाप की,
याद आ गई वो शादी, बात बड़े पुराने साल की।
उस पार फ़ोटो वाले ने, जयमाला की फ़ोटो सजाई,
फ़्रेम पे लिखा साल वही, जब तेरी हुई विदाई।
hi.solved: उन्नीस सौ बयासी! तेरी शादी का साल, दीदी। उसी दिन के बाद हम बिछड़ गए।

en.riddle:
From mausi I bought bangles, Didi, made to fit your hand,
They brought your wedding back to me, the drums, the dancing band.
Across, the photo man has hung your wedding photo high,
Type the year below the picture, the year you said goodbye.
en.solved: Nineteen eighty-two! The year of your wedding, Didi. After that day we lost each other.

puzzles.place: Photo studio: santra goli on the ground in front of it
puzzles.meaning: The time the santra goli shop opens, 5:30. Sanjay is there every evening from then.

answerSource.object: sign "5:30 से खुला" on the santra goli shop

needs.item: Photo studio with the 1982 wedding photo (young Sanjay beside the bride); a santra goli packet on the ground in front
Santra goli shop with a jar of santra goli and a sign: 5:30 से खुला

hi.riddle:
उस फ़ोटो में छोटा-सा मैं, दुल्हन के पास खड़ा,
आज भी हर शाम आता हूँ, बूढ़ा हो के बड़ा।
संतरा गोली की दुकान पे, तख़्ती टँगी है देखो,
किस वक़्त से दुकान खुली है, वो वक़्त यहाँ लिखो।
hi.solved: साढ़े पाँच! दुकान खुलते ही, हर शाम मैं वहीं संतरा गोली लेकर तेरी राह देखता हूँ।

en.riddle:
In that photo I'm the little boy beside the bride,
Now every single evening, old and grey, I wait outside.
Look at the santra goli shop, a little sign is there,
The time from when it opens: type that time with care.
en.solved: Half past five! The moment the shop opens, every evening, I wait there for you with santra goli.

candidates.label: Sanjay (white cap, orange kurta, at the santra goli shop)

hi.voice: दीदी? तुम सच में आ गईं! हर शाम साढ़े पाँच बजे, इसी दुकान पे तुम्हारी राह देखता था। लो, एक संतरा गोली, बिल्कुल पहले जैसी।

en.voice: Didi? You really came! Every evening at half past five I waited here for you. Here, a santra goli, just like before.

candidates.label: A (red turban, blue shirt, beside the santra goli shop)

hi.voice: नहीं बेटा, मैं तो बस गोली लेने आया था। संजय? वो तो यहीं कहीं होगा!

en.voice: No, child, I only came for santra goli. Sanjay? He must be around here somewhere!

candidates.label: B (moustache, red cloth on shoulder, ice candy)

hi.voice: मैं? ना बेटा, मैं तो चुस्की खा रहा हूँ, गला ठंडा कर रहा हूँ। किसे ढूँढ रहे हो?

en.voice: Me? No, child, I am just cooling down with an ice candy. Who are you looking for?

candidates.label: C (grey turban, playing the game drawn on the ground)

hi.voice: अरे, खेल बीच में मत रुकवाओ! मेरी बारी है, बेटा।

en.voice: Don't stop the game now! It's my turn, child.

candidates.label: D (white Gandhi cap, handing out santra goli)

hi.voice: मैं तो बच्चों को संतरा गोली बाँट रहा हूँ, बेटा। तुम भी लोगे?

en.voice: I am just handing out santra goli to the children, child. Want one?

candidates.label: E (Pappu, at his Toy stop stall)

hi.voice: अरे, मैं तो पप्पू हूँ, खिलौने बेचता हूँ! बोतलें गिराओगे?

en.voice: Me? I am Pappu, I sell toys! Want to knock down the bottles?

other_1.label: Bald old man with glasses in the crowd

hi.voice: ना बेटा, मैं तो अपने पोते-पोतियों के साथ मेला घूम रहा हूँ।

en.voice: No, child, I am just walking the mela with my grandchildren.

other_4.label: Old man in white kurta and orange dupatta

hi.voice: ना बेटा, मैं तो बहू के साथ चूड़ियाँ लेने आया हूँ।

en.voice: No, child, I came with my daughter-in-law to buy bangles.

other_5.label: Bearded man in grey cap with a basket

hi.voice: ना बेटा, मैं तो घर के लिए आलू-प्याज़ लेने आया हूँ।

en.voice: No, child, I just came to buy vegetables for home.

hi.voice: मैं तो मटके बनाता हूँ, बेटा। एक मटका लोगे?

en.voice: I make pots, child. Want a matka?

hi: खट्टी-मीठी संतरा गोली संजय को भाए,
जहाँ भी गया, वो गोलियाँ गिराए।
देखो, कौन-सी गोली कहाँ पड़ी है,
हर एक के संग इक पहेली खड़ी है।
en: Sanjay loved his santra goli treat,
And dropped a few on every street.
Look where each santra goli has come to stay,
Each one holds a riddle to point the way.
mr: जिथे गेला तिथे एक गोळी पडे.
पाहा कुठे कुठे गोळी पडली आहे,
प्रत्येक गोळीमागे एक गोष्ट दडली आहे.
gu: જ્યાં જાય ત્યાં એક ગોળી મૂકે.

take.hi: अब फ़ोन को हाथ में लीजिए
take.en: Now take your phone in your hands
